item.title: Allen Graham convicted in fatal Interstate 10 crash, receives maximum sentence
item.description: A Kendall County jury convicted Allen Remard Graham Jr., 28, of San Antonio, of intoxication manslaughter, manslaughter, and intoxication assault in the February 16, 2025 head-on crash on Interstate 10 near Comfort that killed Manuela Rodriguez. He was sentenced to 20 years and 10 years in state prison, the maximum sentences allowed by law.

item.title: Boerne ISD trustees review middle school boundary recommendation
item.description: Boerne ISD trustees reviewed a Campus Boundary Committee recommendation on November 16 to move the Esperanza neighborhood from Boerne Middle School North to Voss Middle School and place the full Fabra Elementary zone in the North zone for 2027-28, with a decision scheduled December 14.

item.title: City of Boerne hosts Adler Road meeting November 18
item.description: The City of Boerne hosts a come-and-go public meeting on Phase 2 of the Adler Road reconstruction on Wednesday, November 18, from 5 to 7 p.m. at Curington Elementary School, 601 Adler Road.

item.title: Commissioners Court agenda lists Comfort setback request, two guarantee releases
item.description: The November 10 Commissioners Court agenda listed a request to reduce setbacks for a proposed development at 714 High Street in Comfort and two releases of financial guarantees for subdivision improvements, totaling $1,027,670.05 and $4,152,025.70.

item.title: Both Boerne ISD teams play Thursday in Laredo
item.description: Boerne High and Boerne Champion play area round playoff games at the same time Thursday, November 19, in Laredo. Boerne faces Mercedes at Shirley Field at 7 p.m., and Champion faces McAllen at the Student Activity Center at 7 p.m.

item.title: Champion beats Eagle Pass Winn 72-0 in playoff opener
item.description: Boerne Champion beat Eagle Pass C. C. Winn 72-0 on Friday night, November 13, at Boerne ISD Stadium in the first round of the Class 5A Division I playoffs, improving to 10-1 and advancing to an area round game against McAllen High. Boerne High also learned its area opponent Friday night: Mercedes, which beat Mission Veterans Memorial 44-42.

item.title: Applicant withdraws Johns Road townhome plan, Boerne council doubles stormwater charge on final reading
item.description: The applicant for a 29-unit townhome project on 6.46 acres at 727A Johns Road withdrew the annexation and rezoning requests at the November 10 Boerne City Council meeting after a public hearing where Hampton Place residents opposed a connection to Hampton Way. The council accepted the withdrawal 5-0, doubled the stormwater charge from $4 to $8 per equivalent resident unit on final reading, adopted Unified Development Code amendments with new data center rules, and awarded a $2,070,000 water treatment plant carbon contract.

item.title: GVTC Foundation awards grants to 183 nonprofits
item.description: The GVTC Foundation awarded 662,754 dollars in Texas Community Grants to 183 nonprofit organizations in 2026 across two funding cycles, with awards from 500 to 15,000 dollars, and marked the total at its 20th Fall Giving Breakfast on November 10.

item.title: Boerne beats Brackenridge 56-14 in playoff opener
item.description: Boerne High beat San Antonio Brackenridge 56-14 on Thursday night, November 12, at Boerne ISD Stadium in the first round of the Class 5A Division II playoffs, improving to 11-0 and advancing to the area round.

item.title: Boerne and Champion girls open basketball season with wins
item.description: Boerne High beat O'Connor 56-42 and Boerne Champion beat Roosevelt 49-31 in their girls basketball season openers, and the Geneva boys beat Savio 57-37.

item.title: Christmas in Comfort marks 40th year November 28
item.description: Christmas in Comfort returns to the Comfort Historic District on Saturday, November 28, for its 40th year, with more than 100 vendors, a tree lighting at 6:30 p.m., a lighted night parade at 7 p.m., and fireworks after the parade.

item.title: Boerne's Veterans Plaza bronze was unveiled 34 years ago
item.description: On November 11, 1992, a bronze sculpture by local sculptor Jay Hester was unveiled atop the Graham monument at Boerne's Veterans Plaza, crowning the 1923 memorial to Kendall County's World War I dead. 34th anniversary.

item.title: New World screwworm found in Bandera County as infested zone returns
item.description: New World screwworm has been detected in Bandera County, and the Texas Animal Health Commission has put Bandera and Medina counties back under an infested zone. Kendall County is not in the zone, but the county emergency management office is urging residents to inspect animals and report anything suspicious right away.

item.title: Purple Heart Project gala honors fallen soldier, raises 80,000 dollars
item.description: The Purple Heart Project held its seventh annual gala Saturday at The Kendall, honoring Army Pfc. Isabella Gonzales and four local Purple Heart recipients, and the auction raised 80,000 dollars.

item.title: Dickens on Main returns November 27 and 28
item.description: Dickens on Main returns to downtown Boerne on Friday, November 27, and Saturday, November 28, with a Christmas market, live music, a snow slide, and the tree lighting Friday evening.

item.title: Boerne and Champion open the playoffs at home
item.description: Boerne High hosts Brackenridge on Thursday night and Champion hosts Eagle Pass Winn on Friday night, both at 7 p.m. at Boerne ISD Stadium, to open the football playoffs.

item.title: Three Boerne-area volleyball seasons end Friday
item.description: Geneva fell in the TAPPS 4A state semifinal, Champion lost a five-set third-round match, and Boerne High was swept in the third round, ending all three Boerne-area volleyball seasons Friday.

item.title: Veterans Day ceremony set for Wednesday at Veterans Plaza
item.description: Boerne's Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 688 and American Legion Post 313 will hold a joint Veterans Day observance Wednesday, November 11, at 11 a.m. at Veterans Plaza, 801 S. Main St.

item.title: TxDOT to update residents on Texas 46 West safety work
item.description: TxDOT officials will give an update on the Texas 46 West safety project at a public session Tuesday, November 10, at 6:30 p.m. at the Patrick Heath Public Library.

item.title: Geneva falls 54-23 to Dallas Christian in first round of playoffs
item.description: Geneva opened the postseason Saturday at Dallas Christian in Mesquite and fell 54-23 in the first round of the TAPPS playoffs, ending the season at 9-2.
